title: etlingera pauciflora
intro: Etlingera pauciflora, commonly known as Pauciflor Kencur or Lesser Kencur, is a type of plant belonging to the Zingiberaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Etlingera pauciflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
